records.question: What is our total realised revenue in USD?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_realised_revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE LIMIT 1000

records.question: How much gross profit did completed orders generate?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(gross_profit_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_gross_profit_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the overall gross margin percentage?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((100.0 * SUM(gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many orders were completed?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS completed_orders FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the average order value of completed orders?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((SUM(revenue_usd) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_order_value_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many distinct customers have at least one completed order?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE LIMIT 1000

records.question: Show realised revenue for each month of the period.
records.sql: SELECT d.year_month, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY d.year_month ORDER BY d.year_month LIMIT 1000

records.question: Rank the products by revenue.
records.sql: SELECT product, SUM(revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY product ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the gross margin percentage of each product?
records.sql: SELECT product, ROUND(CAST((SUM(gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY product ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: For each product, give revenue, gross profit, units sold, gross margin % and its revenue rank.
records.sql: SELECT product, ROUND(CAST(SUM(revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(CAST(SUM(gross_profit_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_profit_usd, SUM(quantity) AS units, ROUND(CAST((SUM(gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_margin_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(revenue_usd) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY product ORDER BY revenue_rank LIMIT 1000

records.question: How is revenue split across regions?
records.sql: SELECT g.region, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(CAST((100.0 * SUM(f.revenue_usd) / SUM(SUM(f.revenue_usd)) OVER ()) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY g.region ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: Revenue per country, highest first.
records.sql: SELECT g.country, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY g.country ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: For every region and country, show revenue, number of orders, gross margin % and number of customers.
records.sql: SELECT g.region, g.country, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders, ROUND(CAST((SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(f.revenue_usd), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_margin_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customers FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY g.region, g.country ORDER BY g.region, g.country LIMIT 1000

records.question: Give yearly revenue with the year-over-year growth in percent.
records.sql: SELECT year, ROUND(CAST(revenue_usd AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(CAST(revenue_yoy_pct AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_yoy_pct FROM analytics.sales_yearly ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the average revenue of each calendar month (January to December) across all years?
records.sql: SELECT d.month_name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(m.monthly_revenue) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_monthly_revenue_usd FROM (SELECT d2.year, d2.month, SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS monthly_revenue FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d2 ON d2.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY d2.year, d2.month) AS m JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.month = m.month GROUP BY d.month, d.month_name ORDER BY d.month LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the revenue by season?
records.sql: SELECT d.season, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY d.season ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which customer segments bring the most revenue?
records.sql: SELECT customer_segment, ROUND(CAST(SUM(revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(CAST((100.0 * SUM(revenue_usd) / SUM(SUM(revenue_usd)) OVER ()) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: Gross margin percentage per customer segment.
records.sql: SELECT customer_segment, ROUND(CAST((100.0 * SUM(gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the revenue per customer in each customer segment?
records.sql: SELECT customer_segment, ROUND(CAST((SUM(revenue_usd) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_per_customer_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY revenue_per_customer_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: Break down revenue by sales channel.
records.sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(CAST(SUM(revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY channel ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: For each customer segment, show customers, revenue, average NPS and average churn probability.
records.sql: SELECT f.customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customers, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(CAST(AVG(c.nps_score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_nps, ROUND(CAST(AVG(c.churn_probability) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_churn_probability FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY f.customer_segment ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What share of all orders were cancelled, in percent?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'Cancelled') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of orders were refunded?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE return_flag = TRUE) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of raw rows passed data validation?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(valid_pct AS DECIMAL), 2) AS valid_pct FROM analytics.quality_report LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many orders are there in each order status?
records.sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_sales GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: Show the data validation report: total, valid and rejected rows, valid %, duration and errors by rule.
records.sql: SELECT total_rows, valid_rows, rejected_rows, valid_pct, duration_seconds, errors_by_rule FROM analytics.quality_report LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which country had the highest realised revenue in 2019?
records.sql: SELECT g.country, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE AND d.year = 2019 GROUP BY g.country ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the top 3 products by gross profit in the EMEA region?
records.sql: SELECT p.product, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_profit_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON g.country = f.country JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product = f.product WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE AND g.region = 'EMEA' GROUP BY p.product ORDER BY gross_profit_usd DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: Show the monthly realised revenue of Product_D in 2020.
records.sql: SELECT d.year_month, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE AND f.product = 'Product_D' AND d.year = 2020 GROUP BY d.year_month ORDER BY d.year_month LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers placed more than 5 completed orders?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_more_than_5_orders FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 5) AS t LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the average discount percentage by sales channel on completed orders?
records.sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(CAST(AVG(discount_pct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY channel ORDER BY avg_discount_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What share of 2023 realised revenue came from the Online channel, in percent?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.channel = 'Online' THEN f.revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.revenue_usd)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS online_revenue_share_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE AND d.year = 2023 LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which customer segment has the highest cancellation rate (cancelled orders over all its orders)?
records.sql: SELECT customer_segment, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'Cancelled') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY cancellation_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the average delivery time in days per region for completed orders?
records.sql: SELECT g.region, ROUND(CAST(AVG(f.days_to_delivery) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY g.region ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: In which quarter of 2022 was realised revenue the highest?
records.sql: SELECT d.quarter, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE AND d.year = 2022 GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders were returned (return flag set), per product?
records.sql: SELECT product, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS returned_orders FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE return_flag = TRUE GROUP BY product ORDER BY returned_orders DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the net profit by payment method for completed orders?
records.sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(CAST(SUM(net_profit_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS net_profit_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY net_profit_usd DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which industry generated the most realised revenue in Germany?
records.sql: SELECT industry, ROUND(CAST(SUM(revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE AND country = 'Germany' GROUP BY industry ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many customers made completed purchases in at least 5 different years?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_5plus_years FROM (SELECT fs.customer_id FROM analytics.fact_sales AS fs JOIN analytics.dim_date AS dd ON dd.date_key = fs.date_key WHERE fs.is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY fs.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dd.year) >= 5) AS t LIMIT 1000

records.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires réalisé total en 2024 ?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE AND d.year = 2024 LIMIT 1000

records.question: Combien de commandes ont été annulées au Japon ?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cancelled_orders FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE country = 'Japan' AND order_status = 'Cancelled' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Quel produit a la meilleure marge brute en pourcentage ?
records.sql: SELECT product, ROUND(CAST((SUM(gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales WHERE is_realised = TRUE GROUP BY product ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Donne le chiffre d'affaires par région pour 2016.
records.sql: SELECT g.region, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales AS f JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised = TRUE AND d.year = 2016 GROUP BY g.region ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1000
